title: Post Clamp Anesthesia Protocol for Mice
author: Louise Lantier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zdnf25e

steps.title: Prepare Pentobarbital Dose
steps.instruction: Calculate and draw the required volume of diluted Pentobarbital (5mg/ml in saline) into a blunted syringe.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volume in uL by multiplying body weight in grams by 7 (Pentobarb (uL) = BW (g) * 7) to achieve a dose of 35mg/kg.

steps.title: Administer Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Steadily inject the pentobarbital into the jugular line of the catheterized mouse.

steps.title: Maintain Anesthesia Depth
steps.instruction: Ensure the mouse is completely anesthetized before taking tissues.

substeps.instruction: If the mouse is not completely anesthetized, inject additional pentobarbital in 50uL increments.
